prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one premium polished 16:9 landscape Chinese Daoist chibi fishing-game UI design. Image 1 is the approved mail artwork, Image 2 the approved team artwork, Image 3 the current fishing gameplay artwork. Match their exact hand-painted art family: deep jade/teal, warm ivory silk-paper panels, thin warm-gold rims, rounded ruyi/cloud carving, soft sophisticated shading, clear readable Chinese. The third reference anchors the turquoise fish world and gourd cannon. References provide style only, do not copy their old names, mail text, test data or team list. Calm paper surfaces and generous aligned spacing; decoration at the outer edge. Main title plaque and primary buttons jade/gold, secondary buttons ivory/gold. Round clear close or back control. Text exactly as specified below, concise with strong size hierarchy. Natural full-screen art, no device mockup, no explanation board except when task explicitly asks state/component board. No photorealism, plastic 3D, excessive sparkle, watermarks, borrowed branding, or extra unreadable text. Preserve native details and do not render a wireframe. Example values are visual mock data.

Task: 16:9 UI state sheet with four generous full window excerpts on quiet ivory/jade, clear 2x2 grid and enough gap. 邮件为空: cute sealed fish/cloud envelope, 暂无邮件. 好友为空: two small jade fish charms, 暂无好友, 添加好友. 数据加载: jade swirl progress/spinner, 正在加载. 获取失败: subdued cloud-scroll icon, 暂时无法获取数据, 重试. Match exact UI family and avoid dramatic warning colors. No lorem ipsum.
